propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE tells FAIL callers that ticket-comment evidence will be considered on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite required for external/ticket-only evidence.

ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md deliberately classify untagged external criteria as codebase-verifiable and reject them on ticket evidence alone; the remediation guidance does not reflect this contract.
The operator followed incomplete remediation guidance and added a ticket comment to an untagged criterion, incurring a second verifier run that failed by design because the tag was absent.

The remediation interface test must require the exact [operator-attested] tag, distinguish codebase-verifiable from operator-attested evidence channels, and state that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone.
Remediation wording should preserve generic guidance and existing no-force posture while affirmatively stating the two evidence channels and the exact tag prerequisite.
